title: Efficiency calculation sheet
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Reactivity (9F); energy transfer by heating
source: Seeded from science/y9 lesson 41 (Efficiency calculation sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 41: Energy transfers and efficiency. To understand that energy is conserved and how to calculate the efficiency of a device

model.title: A kettle takes in 2000 J and transfers 1800 J to the water. Find its efficiency.

questions.q: A phone charger: 50 J in, 40 J into the battery. Efficiency?
Where does most wasted energy go?
questions.a: To the surroundings as heating (thermal energy)
You cannot get more energy out than you put in

questions.q: Calculate efficiencies for six devices on the sheet (for example a toaster 1000 J in, 850 J useful).
questions.a: Toaster 85%; others on the answer sheet

questions.q: Suggest two ways to reduce wasted energy in a car engine.
questions.a: Lubricate moving parts to reduce friction; streamline the body to reduce drag.

questions.q: A 40% efficient motor must deliver 600 J. What input is needed?
Big question: why keep paying for energy if it is not destroyed?
questions.a: It is dissipated as heat and spread out, so it is no longer useful.
